About

A holiday tradition since 2012, The Nutcracker returns to enchant audiences with a cast of professional guest artists—including stars from the New York City Ballet, alongside rising talent from across Texas and pre-professional dancers from the Brazos Valley. For its 14th anniversary season, Ballet Brazos is proud to feature live music performed by the Brazos Valley Symphony Orchestra at every performance, adding a new dimension of magic to Tchaikovsky’s beloved score.

This is a special partnership between the Brazos Valley Symphony Orchestra and Ballet Brazos and is not part of the BVSO's regular subscription season.

More Information and Tickets

Tickets to the Ballet Brazos Nutcracker are sold exclusively through the MSC Box Office, and never through third party ticketing sources. These sources may sell tickets at much higher prices than the price listed on our website. Please be aware and purchase tickets through the MSC Box Office only.
